title: Defer secondary frames into bounded backlog
summary: CPT Manager and Integrations frames remain future Agentic Ops subplans until the Filter Preset first slice passes QA.
rationale: The implementation needs one stable shared admin architecture before adding more module families.
alternatives_considered: Mix CPT and Integrations frames into first-slice tasks
risks: Future module plans must still revalidate whether runtime adapters are in scope.
